external_entities.description: Backend services operated by other teams that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: The source refers to these as 'other teams' backends' and also as 'calling services'.

external_entities.description: Users of the teams calling the inference gateway, whose typed content may appear in prompts.

external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: FastAPI service that receives inference requests, forwards them to the model server, and writes requests and responses to the inference log.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE

processes.name: model server
processes.description: Server that runs the actual model, loads model artifacts, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says the artifact integrity is trusted without verification: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_stores.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified. It also says ML engineers publish artifacts here and that push governance is uncertain: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: Redis store containing customer features such as account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts when present.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference
data_flows.description: Other team backends send inference requests to the gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for this. The source does not state the protocol.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from Redis for inference requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.data_description: customer features, including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes each request and response to the BigQuery inference log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: every inference request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket
data_flows.notes: The source is uncertain about who can push and says it may be a shared group account: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: Network containing the GPU nodes running the model server and the Redis feature store.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: GPU nodes in our model network

assumptions.basis: The source identifies the gateway as a FastAPI service.

assumptions.basis: It contains account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-related personal data.
